description: Four-chamber heart built from heart's nested module_types (modules/heart/cardiac_clock, chamber, valve): a cardiac clock, one generic chamber per chamber (ra, rv, la, lv) and a Mynard valve between each chamber and its outflow (trv, puv, miv, aov). In a model, each submodule is named <instance>__<submodule> (e.g. heart__ra), and the host vessels that couple to it are given in the instance's per_submodule_inputs / per_submodule_outputs: typically systemic venous return into ra, pulmonary venous return into la, puv and aov out to the pulmonary and systemic arteries, and the chambers' volumes out to a volume_sum. Several inflows into an atrium go through a flow_merge vessel in the host.
